leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Construct a custom React hook to encapsulate data fetching logic with TypeScript generics.
Implement useState to manage loading, error, and data states within the custom hook.
Apply useEffect to trigger API calls when dependencies change and handle cleanup.
Utilize async/await syntax to handle asynchronous fetch operations within the hook.
Execute conditional rendering in components based on loading, error, and data states.
Define TypeScript interfaces to type the response data and hook return values.
Invoke the custom useFetch hook within functional components to retrieve data.
Handle error states by catching exceptions and updating the error state appropriately.
Control component re-renders by managing dependency arrays in useEffect.
Return structured data from the hook including loading status, error messages, and fetched data.
Modify hook parameters to accept dynamic URLs and configuration options for fetch.
Compare different states (loading, error, success) to determine what UI to render.
